Name: Party Info
Author: Yousv
Description:
[center][color=#f6b26b][b][size=6]PartyInfo[/size][/b][/color][/center]
[center][size=5]Multiplayer overlay, player health, energy, location, skills, status notifications[/size][/center]
[line]

[b][size=5]Player Head Overlay[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Displays head portraits of all connected players along the top, left, or right edge of the screen.[/*]
[*]Toggle visibility with a configurable keybind (default LeftAlt + C).[/*]
[*]Toggle interactions while a menu is open with the Menu Work option.[/*]
[*]Heads slide in when a player comes online with a 500ms eased animation.[/*]
[*]Offline players show a red Offline label. They can be hidden entirely via the Show Offline toggle.[/*]
[*]Show your own head with the Show Self toggle.[/*]
[*]Online players show a green Online notification when they reconnect.[/*]
[/list]
[b][size=5]Top Position Layout[/size][/b]
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/48739/48739-1784114701-352725343.gif[/img][/center]
[b][size=5]Left Position Layout[/size][/b]
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/48739/48739-1784114690-1482354187.gif[/img][/center]
[b][size=5]Status Notifications[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Notifications appear below heads with priority ordering: Knocked Out, Critical, Exhausted, Offline.[/*]
[*][b]Knocked Out[/b] - health reaches zero. Red text, 500ms duration, no threshold.[/*]
[*][b]Critical[/b] - health drops below a configurable threshold (default 30%). Red text with vertical shake.[/*]
[*][b]Exhausted[/b] - stamina drops below a configurable threshold (default 10%). Green text with vertical shake.[/*]
[*]Each notification type has its own GMCM sub-page with settings for duration, fade timing, head shake direction and intensity, and status text shake.[/*]
[*]Notifications can be suppressed while hovering over a head (Mute Notifications toggle, default on). Mute lasts a configurable duration (default 10s).[/*]
[/list][center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/48739/48739-1784115035-1719233849.gif[/img] [img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/48739/48739-1784114695-760319026.gif[/img][/center]
[b][size=5]Persistent Status[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]A configurable dropdown selects what appears below each head when no notification is active: None, Location, Health, Energy.[/*]
[*][b]Location[/b] - shows the player's current area name, including custom locations added by mods. Green for safe zones, red for dangerous areas (mines, skull cavern, volcano, sewers).[/*]
[*][b]Health[/b] - shows current and max health as numbers (example: 45/150). Uses health bar red color.[/*]
[*][b]Energy[/b] - shows current and max stamina as numbers (example: 180/270). Uses stamina bar green color.[/*]
[*]The gap between head and status text is adjustable (Status Text Offset, default 28px).[/*]
[*]A black background box behind status text can be enabled with configurable transparency (Status BG, default on at 15% alpha).[/*]
[/list]
[b][size=5]Tooltips[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Hover over a head to show a tooltip box with stat bars and location.[/*]
[*]Tooltip shows the player name with status tags appended inline (Knocked Out, Critical, Exhausted, Offline, Awaiting).[/*]
[*]Health and stamina bars display current and max values.[/*]
[*]Location line below the bars shows the player's current area.[/*]
[*]Hover and unhover have a configurable animation speed (Hover Speed, default 50ms).[/*]
[/list]
[b][size=5]Skill Tooltips[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Hold the Skills Key (default LeftShift) while hovering to transition from stat tooltips to skill tooltips.[/*]
[*]Shows Farming, Mining, Foraging, Fishing, and Combat levels.[/*]
[*]Profession names are listed under each skill. Supports vanilla, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]SpaceCore[/url], and DaLion.Professions custom skill professions, including custom professions added by mods like [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24355]Walk of Life[/url].[/*]
[*]Prestiged professions (DaLion) display as Prestiged [BaseName].[/*]
[/list]
[b][size=5]Show All Mode[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Hold the Show All Key (default C) to display tooltips for all players simultaneously.[/*]
[*]Spacing between heads expands to fit the widest tooltip.[/*]
[*]Tooltips fade in and out at configurable speeds (Fade In, Fade Out, default 50ms each).[/*]
[*]Expand and collapse animations have separate configurable speeds (Expand Speed, Collapse Speed, default 100ms each).[/*]
[/list]
[b][size=5]Health Sync[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Broadcasts local health and stamina data every 15 ticks via SMAPI messaging.[/*]
[*]All tooltips and notification triggers read synced data for remote players, ensuring accurate readings.[/*]
[/list]
[b][size=5]Time Control Integration[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]When [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/49186]Time Control[/url] (yousv.TimeControl) is installed, players who have voted to pause show a gold Paused label on their head.[/*]
[*]Pause state is synced from the host to all clients via SMAPI messaging.[/*]
[*]Toggle with the Time Control option (default on).[/*]
[/list]
[b][size=5]Credits[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Inspired by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2173]MoreMultiplayerInfo[/url] by CheesySteak.[/*]
[/list]
[center][b][size=5]Configuration[/size][/b][/center]
All options are edited through [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]. Notification types (Critical, Exhausted, Knocked Out) have their own sub-pages accessible via page links at the bottom of the config menu.
[line]

[center][size=5][b]Requirements[/b][/size][/center]
[list]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url] 3.18.0 or later.[/*]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6.15 or later.[/*]
[/list]Optional: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] for in-game configuration. Without it, edit the config.json file directly.
Optional: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/49186]Time Control[/url] for Paused status integration.
[line]

[center][size=5][b]Installation[/b][/size][/center]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Extract the mod folder into your Mods directory.[/*]
[*]Run the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list][line]

[center][size=5][b]Support[/b][/size][/center]
